note: Second blind labeller on ten of the 32 H-B2 unintended misses (owner decision 4 of 2026-11-03), before any publication of H-B2. Sample: seeded (text hb2-second-labeller-2026-11-03), stratified 5 capability + 5 configuration by the first labeller's label (balanced on purpose: kappa on 7 against 3 would say little about the rarer label). The labeller read only a packet per miss (kind, the author's description, the named operation, the files, the engine result, objective facts about the operation) and the rule with the legend of blocker codes; it did not see the first labels. Per-seed labels stay outside the repository (they paraphrase seed content). The labels are post-measurement judgments of two instances of one model family under a rule written by the implementer; they were not tested by a re-run.
